info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Group Invites API

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`

params.name: groupId
params.description: The unique identifier of the target [group](https://docs.coveo.com/en/2867/).</br>**Example:**`myorganization-bfghkjfjb674jh5egjk`

items.docs:
Lists all invites of a [group](https://docs.coveo.com/en/2867/).

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"GROUP","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```

items.docs:
Invites a user to a [group](https://docs.coveo.com/en/2867/).

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"GROUP","type":"EDIT","targetId":"{groupId}"} ```
